exposure: Mothers who received Vit D supplements
Mothers who did not receive Vit D supplements
cohort: This study included 248 neonates and their mothers in Greece from September 2019 to January 2022.
finding: The study found a strong association between maternal and neonatal 25(OH)D concentrations at birth, with neonates tending to have lower levels than their mothers, even with maternal vitamin D supplementation.
